title: help
state: Info
body:
Getting started
Type a task and press Enter.
/model — Switch model
/connect — Connect or reconnect a provider
/help — List commands and keys

Primary
/help — List commands and keys
/goal [OBJECTIVE|edit …|budget N|pause|resume|clear] — Inspect or control a multi-turn goal
/context [NAME|default] — Show context usage or choose a window
/status [--verbose] — Show session, usage, and workspace status
/model [PROVIDER/MODEL] — Switch model
/details — Toggle bounded live tool detail
/timeline — Show local turn, child, and recovery history
/new — Start a fresh session
/resume [ID] — Resume a saved session
/connect [PROVIDER] — Connect or reconnect a provider
/disconnect [PROVIDER] — Disconnect a provider
/think [on|off|default] — Set thinking for the next turn
/effort [LEVEL|default] — Set reasoning effort for the next turn
/advisor [on|off|default|TARGET] — Turn the advisor on or off, or choose it
/account [N] — Show provider accounts and their usage
/agent [ID|resume ID] — List, inspect, or resume an existing agent
/mcp [trust NAME] — Show MCP servers, or trust one so it may run
/capabilities [deny ID|allow ID] — Show capabilities, or deny one for this session
/skills [trust NAME] — Show indexed skills, or trust one this project ships
/commands [trust NAME|reload] — Show file commands, trust one, or reload the catalog
/diff [SCOPE] — Inspect workspace changes
/review [SCOPE] — Run a read-only change review
/undo — Undo the last attributable turn
/redo — Reapply the newest exact undone turn
/revert [FILE] — Selectively revert a file or hunk

Advanced
/diagnostics — Show detailed cache and recovery diagnostics
/profile [NAME] — Switch configured profile
/provider [NAME] — Switch provider
/quit — Exit Smith

Composer
? or /help shows this local guide without contacting the model.
Tab cycles the configured profile order only while empty and idle.
While work is serving, Enter steers an ordinary prompt and Tab queues it.
Alt+Up restores the newest explicit queued turn for editing.
Esc interrupts; uncommitted steers are resent only after cancellation discards them.
Ctrl+B moves a running foreground shell command to the background without killing it.
@ completes exact files and read-only agents; @@ sends a literal @.
! runs a prepared local shell action; !! sends a literal !.
PageUp/PageDown/Home/End or the mouse wheel scrolls the transcript.
Up/Down browse accepted and Ctrl+C-stashed input without losing your draft.
Down past the newest draft walks the delegated agents; the transcript shows
that agent's log, Enter continues it, and Esc returns to the root timeline.
Ctrl+R searches composer history; Enter restores a match and Esc cancels.
Ctrl+C twice within 1s exits; the first press stashes and clears the draft.
Start a message with // to send a literal leading slash.
